title.narrative: Strengthening Capacities of Co-operatives and Member-Based Organizations Project

description.narrative: The Strengthening Capacities of Co-operative Societies and Member-Based Organizations in Tanzania (CACOSMBO II) project is jointly implemented by We Effect and Moshi Co-operative University (MoCU) across seven regions: Njombe, Iringa, Kilimanjaro, Dodoma, Mbeya, Tabora, and Mtwara. Launched in 2023, the project addresses challenges limiting co-operatives and member-based organizations (MBOs), including weak governance, poor financial management, low member engagement, and limited leadership capacity, as highlighted in the COASCO Report (2021/2022). The project's main focus is to build inclusive, ethical, gender-responsive, and environmentally responsible co-operatives capable of thriving in Tanzania's evolving socio-economic context. Through the Leadership for Change (LFC) programme, CACOSMBO II strengthens leadership, entrepreneurship, and change-management skills among leaders, board members, and ordinary members, with a focus on women, youth, and persons with disabilities (PWDs). Key activities include structured training, action-oriented research, policy advocacy, value chain engagement, business development services, and promotion of climate-smart and digital solutions. Expected results include enhanced governance, empowered members, and sustainable, high-performing co-operatives that drive economic empowerment, social justice, and resilient community development across Tanzania.
